products.name: tl;dv
products.note: Meeting recorder AI; timestamped notes; EU-hosted; GDPR; consent management

profile_text.body:
tl;dv is an AI meeting notetaker founded in 2021, built to work with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The name stands for "Too Long, Didn't View." The product automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes calls, then generates timestamped notes, follow-up email drafts, and next-step tasks based on the conversation. It supports transcription and translation across more than 30 languages and dialects, and integrates with CRMs, ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, and what the company describes as over 5,000 other tools.

Beyond note-taking, tl;dv positions itself as a sales coaching platform, offering AI-driven call analysis that the company says allows sales managers to track playbook adherence, monitor objection handling, and review representative performance. Multi-meeting analysis can surface aggregated trends and feature requests across conversations, and AI-generated reports can be delivered directly to users' inboxes. The company partners with Anthropic to provide generative AI capabilities, and describes its security posture as including end-to-end encryption, GDPR compliance, SOC 2 certification, ISO 27001-certified data centers, and AES-256 encryption. The company states it does not use customer recordings or transcripts to train AI.

The held facts confirm tl;dv carries a single tracked product under the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category, noted for EU-hosted infrastructure and consent management. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are associated with the company in the held data.
